The structure of Sc₃Mo crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—six Sc and two Mo—distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Mo and Sc centers in close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors per atom, where Mo is surrounded by 12 Sc neighbors and Sc is coordinated by 4 Mo and 8 Sc neighbors. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron contacts indicate that 12-vertex Sc and Mo coordination polyhedra exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing.
